summary: The Joint Corp. filed an 8-K reporting third-quarter 2026 results (Item 2.02), posting an earnings presentation for its November 5, 2026 call (Item 7.01), and disclosing a board-authorized $5.0 million increase to its existing stock repurchase program (Item 8.01). The added authorization runs until November 4, 2027 or until exhausted or terminated by the board. No price, share count, or premium is stated. Repurchases may occur via open market, privately negotiated transactions, block trades, derivatives, or accelerated share repurchase transactions, subject to market conditions and legal requirements. No advisor is named. Watch buyback execution pace and whether repurchase activity signals management's view of intrinsic value; this is a capital-return action, not a takeover event.
